description: If you visualize multi-level flows in Power BI — customer journeys, revenue attribution, supply chains, or process diagrams — basic bar and line charts can't show how value moves between stages. ProSankey helps you turn flat tables into clear, interactive Sankey flow diagrams that reveal the full path from source to outcome. Use ProSankey to map any multi-level flow without manual reshaping, trace a single customer journey from acquisition to conversion, identify where volume is lost or gained between stages, and present flow analytics in stakeholder meetings without leaving Power BI. For example, drop in four categorical columns from a flat table and ProSankey draws the entire flow automatically — no source-target reshaping or Power Query required. Unlike simple Sankey visuals that crash on circular data or require manual edge lists, ProSankey is built for enterprise flow reporting: it supports three input modes (Path, Graph, Hybrid), detects and renders loops without breaking layout, traces full upstream and downstream paths on click, and scales to thousands of nodes and edges with sub-second rendering. Key Features Multi-mode input - Path Mode binds N-level columns directly, Graph Mode accepts explicit Source → Target edges, and Hybrid Mode combines both, so you skip data preparation regardless of how your data is shaped.
